rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and appropriately discusses ICM, TE, and zona thinning, but includes some speculative image details not reliably inferable from a single static image and shows mild inconsistency around TE grading in the reasoning.

Integrates age, BMI, FSH, male factor diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, prior IVF history, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis; only minor gaps such as limited discussion of absent AMH and unclear handling of the COCs field.

Overall logic is understandable and mostly supported, but there are notable inconsistencies: conflicting comments about male factor, COCs/oocyte yield interpretation, and some overconfident implantation estimates relative to the stated uncertainty.

Largely aligned with standard IVF practice: recognizes morphology limits, supports single good-quality Day-5 transfer, emphasizes luteal support and lifestyle optimization, and appropriately frames PGT-A as optional rather than mandatory. Minor deviations include somewhat inflated implantation estimates and a few speculative comments.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support review, cavity assessment, lifestyle modification, early pregnancy monitoring, and future stimulation review. Recommendations are useful, though some are broad rather than protocol-specific.
